messages.subject: ggsave path encoding
messages.body_plain:
Hello everyone!

When I try to save a graphic in a folder path that contains characters of the Portuguese alphabet, the error

"Error: cannot open stream  Apresentação/Gráficos/ OUVIDORIA//ouvidoria.svg" appears.

The code I run is

ggsave(filename = "audioria.svg",device = "svg", path = "Apresentação/Gráficos/OUVIDORIA/")

If I run the same code as

ggsave(filename = "ouvidoria.svg",device = "svg", path = " Apresentacao/Graficos/ OUVIDORIA/  ")

The error disappears.

Many thanks!

messages.subject: Re: ggsave path encoding
messages.body_plain:
I am no expert, but normally I use

Sys.setlocale("LC_ALL", "es_ES.UTF-8")

to get R understand the Spanish characters (including "ñ"!); you may use it -changing es_ES for the adequate portuguese symbols- at the beginning of your program, and have the added benefit of using Portuguese for your titles, captions, etc.

Hope it helps!

Elías Cárdenes
